source: FARS crash points (NHTSA) x modeled OSRM walking routes from each tract's internal point to its nearest FQHC
model_notes: Routes are MODELED walking paths (one Census internal point per tract, nearest FQHC by walk), not observed foot traffic. A crash 'on' a corridor means within 150 m of the routed line. Counts are points near a line, never rates — per-corridor numbers are far too small for statistical claims. Evidence of overlap, not causation.
